# Jinra controller artwork

These Xbox and DualSense layout images were generated for Jinra with AI assistance.
The adjacent prompt files record their creation instructions. The app renders them
as layout references; the Controls page labels automatic detection, saved mappings
and manual previews separately.

The artwork is included under the repository's GPL-3.0-or-later distribution terms.
Controller product names and symbols identify the corresponding layouts; no
manufacturer affiliation or endorsement is claimed.
